tasks.AnalyzeConditionForNonFixedPoints: Analyze conditions for which there exists an x in [0, 1] such that f(x) ≠ x but f(f(x)) = x.
tasks.DefineFunction: Define the function f(x) = λx(1 - x).
tasks.FindFixedPoints: Find fixed points of the function where f(x) = x.
tasks.SolveEquationForLambda: Solve the equation derived from the condition to find values of λ.
